title: Up For Grabs open-source tasks
eligibility_text: Up For Grabs lists public open-source tasks curated by participating projects; repository contribution terms apply.
cost_notes: The adapter records only public programme metadata. Confirm current eligibility, price, availability and terms at the official source.

normalized_terms.acceptance_criteria: Issue-specific acceptance criteria are stated in the listed repository issue.
normalized_terms.authorization_scope: Only work on repositories and issues where the project grants permission.
normalized_terms.payout_condition: No payment is inferred from this directory; check the repository issue for any reward terms.
normalized_terms.dispute_process: Use the contribution and maintainer process stated by the listed project.

retention: private local raw archive; operational retention; no automatic deletion
use: public open-source task metadata for personal discovery; no source-body republication
